title: Revisiting the Vibrational Force Field of Matrix-Isolated [Fe(CO)4]-
content: The 17-e anion, [Fe(CO)4]- , was first characterised in 1981 by Breeze et al.  We subsequently challenged their interpretation, suggesting that they had produced  [Fe(CO)3]-.   In the light of new calculations here, we withdraw that view.  We confirm that [Fe(CO)4]-  has the  C3v structure (as previously reported) and we have calculated the following, new, energy-factored force constants:        k1 = 1437.2     k2 = 1456.2     k11 = 48.6     k12 = 47.7 where  k1 refers to the three chemically identical equatorial CO groups and  k2 refers to the sole axial CO group ( k11 and k12 are the CO,CO interaction constants).  This force field is significantly different from that originally proposed.
